description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides several HTTP endpoints for greeting, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller handling basic endpoints like greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and info for a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message for the root endpoint.

methods.name: docs
